profile.name: SANKALP YERAWAR
profile.subtitle: Backend Developer & Distributed Systems Architect
summary: 7+ years building scalable backend systems and event-driven microservices across automotive, healthcare, and manufacturing
Proficient in Kotlin, Java, and C# with hands-on expertise in Kafka, Cassandra, PostgreSQL, and AWS
Practitioner of Clean Architecture, DDD, and TDD — focused on reliability and maintainability
Actively using AI-assisted development (Kiro, Copilot) via custom agents, context engineering, and prompt design to accelerate delivery
Collaborative team player in Agile environments, bridging technical and non-technical stakeholders to drive business outcomes

projects.title: Personal Portfolio Website
projects.description: A minimal, responsive portfolio website built with Vite and Vanilla JS. Features dynamic JSON content loading and a clean UI. Redesigned using Google Stitch for UI design and migrated to Tailwind CSS, with Google Jules assisting in development.

projects.title: AI-Assisted Development Handbook
projects.description: A best-practices reference for setting up projects to maximize AI coding tools like Google Antigravity, GitHub Copilot, and Claude.

experience.title: Technology Consultant
experience.summary: Building scalable serverless ETL platforms and enabling teams with AI-assisted development practices. Focus on high-quality delivery through agile execution and robust backend architecture.

nestedProjects.title: Automated Per Diem ETL Platform
nestedProjects.summary: Designed a serverless ETL platform using AWS Step Functions and Java Lambdas to automate per diem rate processing. Built a unified data model and validation framework, reducing manual errors and ensuring regulatory compliance.

nestedProjects.title: On-Demand Learning Platform
nestedProjects.summary: Built a full-stack internal learning platform using Spring Boot, React/TypeScript, and PostgreSQL in a monorepo setup. Leveraged Kiro and Antigravity as primary AI coding tools — applying context engineering, custom skills, and reusable prompts to streamline development. Designed structured workflows and custom agents tailored for planning, story creation, implementation, and review across the stack.
